extracted.intended_audience: individual predoctoral and postdoctoral fellowship applicants preparing an NIH PHS 416-1 biographical sketch
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and a filled sample (PHS 416-1) for preparing the Biographical Sketch required for individual predoctoral and postdoctoral NIH fellowships, showing required sections, order, and example content. Intended to be used as the applicant's biosketch template/guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form use and applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: USE ONLY FOR INDIVIDUAL PREDOCTORAL and POSTDOCTORAL FELLOWSHIPS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use this format for other mechanisms. Follow directions specific to individual fellowship applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: The Biographical Sketch may not exceed four pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the formats and instructions on the attached sample. Ensure all content for sections A–D fits within the four-page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required identification fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide applicant name, position title, and eRA Commons user name (credential, e.g., agency login).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete header fields exactly as requested (NAME OF FELLOWSHIP APPLICANT, POSITION TITLE, eRA COMMONS USER NAME).

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training section content and order
rubrics_metrics.description: Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education and include postdoctoral training. For each entry provide INSTITUTION AND LOCATION, DEGREE (if applicable), YEAR(s), and FIELD OF STUDY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List education/training chronologically starting with the earliest degree. Use the sample table format as a model.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement content
rubrics_metrics.description: A narrative describing long term research interests; academic training and research experience relevant to the proposed training; prior research accomplishments and publications; choice of sponsor; proposed training plan and career development activities; and career goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how prior training prepares you for the proposed fellowship, the conceptual/technical training you will gain, and career development activities (e.g., grant writing, public speaking, lab management). If applicable, briefly explain any interruptions or gaps in training that affected productivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Honors — listing requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: List in chronological order all non-degree training (including postdoctoral research training), all employment after college, and any military service. State the Activity/Occupation and include beginning/end dates, field, name of institution/company, and the name of your supervisor/employer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clinicians should also include information on internship, residency and specialty board certification (actual and anticipated with dates). Use a clear table or chronological list as in the sample.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic and Professional Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: List any academic and professional honors, including all scholarships, traineeships, fellowships, and development awards other than Kirschstein-NRSA. Indicate sources of awards, dates, and grant or award numbers. List current memberships in professional societies, if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include concise entries showing award name, source, and dates. Provide society membership listings if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publications — scope and formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: List your entire bibliography, separating research papers, abstracts, book chapters and reviews. Within each subsection the list should be chronological. Manuscripts 'submitted for publication' or 'in preparation' should be included and identified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For publicly available citations, URLs or PMC submission identification numbers may accompany the full reference. Copies of publicly available publications are not accepted as appendix material. Follow the sample's citation style and subsectioning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of in-preparation / submitted manuscripts
rubrics_metrics.description: Manuscripts 'submitted for publication' or 'in preparation' should be included and identified within the publications list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly label items as 'in preparation' or 'submitted' rather than as published, as shown in the sample.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scholastic Performance — detail required
rubrics_metrics.description: Predoctoral applicants: list by institution and year all undergraduate and graduate courses with grades. Postdoctoral applicants: list by institution and year all undergraduate courses and graduate scientific and/or professional courses germane to the training sought under this award with grades.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided chart format. In the space following the chart, explain marking system if other than 1–100; A, B, C, D, F, or 0–4.0. Show level required for passing. Predoctoral applicants should provide GRE scores if available; MD/PhD applicants should provide MCAT scores if available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chronological organization requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Where specified (Positions, Publications, Education/Training), entries should be presented in chronological order (the sample uses chronological lists within subsections).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Within each subsection keep ordering consistent (e.g., earliest to latest or vice versa as illustrated) and clearly label dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supervisor/employer identification
rubrics_metrics.description: For positions and training entries include the name of your supervisor/employer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide supervisor names for each position/training entry as in the sample (e.g., 'Supervisor/Employer: I.M. Creative').

rubrics_metrics.name: Format adherence and referencing application instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the formats and instructions on the attached sample. Please refer to the application instructions in order to complete sections A, B, C, and D of the Biographical Sketch.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere strictly to the sample organization and the PHS 416-1 form version referenced (PHS 416-1 (Rev. 06/05)). Deviations may render the biosketch noncompliant.
